Scenario fixture: field-label-in-name-sources

Each target has a stable id of the form fins_case_NN. RGAA 11.2.5 checks that the aria-label, the aria-labelledby text, the title and the <label> of a field each contain its visible label. Punctuation and capital letters are ignored; accents are not.

07 — PASS: aria-labelledby text that contains the label
